features.available_timestamp: bar open_time + 8h; included only when <= decision_time
features.endpoint_archive: data.binance.vision USD-M monthly klines, 8h; frozen bars.parquet
features.event_timestamp: open_time (bar interval starts); close event is open_time + 8h
features.lag: latest input is the bar ending at t; fill open stamped t is hidden
features.missing_behavior: no forward fill or interpolation; current 72h exact grid failure excludes symbol; prior pair is skipped and fewer than 48/60 excludes symbol
features.transformation: adjacent log returns, 72h displacement divided by realized-root-sum-square; prior-60-day median/MAD z-score

features.available_timestamp: funding_time, admitted only when funding_time < decision_time
features.endpoint_archive: data.binance.vision USD-M monthly fundingRate; official /fapi/v1/fundingRate only for frozen archive gaps
features.missing_behavior: sum actual events; no-event window is zero only after first observed event; pre-first-event is missing; snapshot coverage failure is not repaired
features.transformation: 72h cumulative rate; prior-60-day median/MAD z-score; cross-sectional Theil-Sen residual

features.available_timestamp: Monday 00:00 UTC reconstitution, then current decision intersection with executable opens
features.endpoint_archive: frozen membership.parquet derived from prior 30 complete days of Binance 8h quote volume and contract metadata
features.lag: ranking uses only completed dates before reconstitution
features.missing_behavior: never substitute a survivor or ineligible symbol; insufficient executable cross-section requests flat

features.available_timestamp: ex post at its timestamp; never passed as a feature
features.lag: future relative to decision feature set
features.transformation: next-open fill and 24h forward research label only

features.available_timestamp: prior completed 24h for participation; funding event for cashflow
features.endpoint_archive: frozen bars.quote_volume, funding.mark_price, and boundary mark_prices
features.missing_behavior: fail closed; never imputed by strategy
features.transformation: participation cap, risk marks, actual funding, fees and slippage; not signal inputs
